blocks.en: Section 3: Sampling Methods

blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Sampling Method Selection | 取樣方法選擇
blocks.en: Sampling Method Selection

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：四種取樣方法
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four Sampling Methods

blocks.zh: TR49 定義了四種主要取樣方法，各有適用情境：
blocks.en: TR49 defines four main sampling methods, each suited to different situations:

blocks.zh: 直接取樣（Direct Sampling）：目視檢查（Visual Inspection）
blocks.en: Direct Sampling: visual inspection

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣（Swab Sampling）：擦拭特定表面
blocks.en: Swab Sampling: wiping a defined surface

blocks.zh: 沖洗取樣（Rinse Sampling）：分析最後沖洗水
blocks.en: Rinse Sampling: analyzing the final rinse water

blocks.zh: 安慰劑取樣（Placebo Sampling）：模擬製程後取樣
blocks.en: Placebo Sampling: sampling after simulating the process

blocks.zh: 重要術語澄清
blocks.en: Key Terminology Clarification

blocks.zh: TR49 特別更正了術語混淆問題：法規文件（如 FDA）將棉棒取樣稱為「直接」取樣，但 TR49 建議保留「直接取樣」一詞專指目視檢查，避免歧義。
blocks.en: TR49 specifically corrects a terminology problem: regulatory documents (such as FDA guidance) call swab sampling "direct" sampling, but TR49 recommends reserving the term "direct sampling" for visual inspection only, to avoid ambiguity.

blocks.zh: 實務上：棉棒取樣 = Swab Sampling；沖洗取樣 = Rinse Sampling。
blocks.en: In practice: swab sampling = Swab Sampling; rinse sampling = Rinse Sampling.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy

blocks.zh: 就像清潔廚房鍋具後，你可以：用眼睛看（目視）、用紙巾擦（棉棒）、用水沖後驗水（沖洗）、或用鍋子再煮一次純水來檢驗（安慰劑）。每種方法偵測角度不同。
blocks.en: It is like cleaning a kitchen pot. You can look at it with your eyes (visual), wipe it with a paper towel (swab), rinse it with water and test the water (rinse), or boil pure water in it again to test it (placebo). Each method detects residue from a different angle.

blocks.zh: Direct Sampling Methods | 直接取樣方法
blocks.en: Direct Sampling Methods

blocks.zh: 直接取樣 = 目視檢查
blocks.en: Direct sampling = visual inspection

blocks.zh: TR49 的「直接取樣」專指目視方法，而非棉棒。目視檢查雖然直觀，但存在關鍵限制：管道內部、焊縫等區域無法以肉眼直視。
blocks.en: In TR49, "direct sampling" refers specifically to visual methods, not swabs. Visual inspection is intuitive, but it has a key limitation: areas such as the inside of piping and weld seams cannot be seen directly with the naked eye.

blocks.zh: 實務提示
blocks.en: Practical Tip

blocks.zh: 遠端攝影機的錄影功能對訓練計畫很有價值，但要注意：局部放大拍攝的照片可能讓殘留看起來比實際更嚴重，不宜作為定量依據。
blocks.en: The recording function of a remote camera is very valuable for training programs, but note that close-up photos of a small area can make residue look worse than it really is, so they should not be used as a quantitative basis.

blocks.zh: Rinse Sampling | 沖洗取樣
blocks.en: Rinse Sampling

blocks.zh: 沖洗取樣三種方式
blocks.en: Three Ways to Do Rinse Sampling

blocks.zh: 方式一：抓取樣（Grab Sample） — 直接從 CIP 最後沖洗水取樣，最常見
blocks.en: Option 1: Grab sample — taken directly from the final CIP rinse water; the most common

blocks.zh: 方式二：充滿取樣 — 清潔後注滿水，取批量樣品
blocks.en: Option 2: Fill sampling — fill with water after cleaning and take a sample of the full volume

blocks.zh: 方式三：獨立取樣沖洗 — 在最後沖洗後額外執行一次定量沖洗
blocks.en: Option 3: Separate sampling rinse — perform an additional quantitative rinse after the final rinse

blocks.zh: CIP 取樣選擇指引
blocks.en: CIP Sampling Selection Guidance

blocks.zh: 抓取樣的優勢：代表正常製程，可即時線上測試，不需額外用水，直接用於殘留量計算。
blocks.en: Advantages of a grab sample: it represents the normal process, can be tested online in real time, needs no additional water, and is used directly in the residue calculation.

blocks.zh: 獨立沖洗的優勢：代表清潔完成後實際表面狀態，更接近真實殘留情形。
blocks.en: Advantages of a separate rinse: it represents the actual surface condition after cleaning is complete, and is closer to the real residue situation.

blocks.zh: 在法規驗證中，抓取樣雖然代表「最差情況（Worst Case）」殘留至下批次，但這也是其優點：可證明清潔製程的穩健性。
blocks.en: In regulatory validation, although a grab sample represents the "worst case" residue carried into the next batch, that is also its advantage: it demonstrates the robustness of the cleaning process.

blocks.zh: 小零件取樣特殊處理
blocks.en: Special Handling for Sampling Small Parts

blocks.zh: 萃取法（Extraction）：將零件浸入溶劑並震盪/超音波處理，適用表面積明確的零件。
blocks.en: Extraction: immerse the part in solvent and agitate or sonicate it; suitable for parts with a well-defined surface area.

blocks.zh: 管腔沖洗法（Lumen Flush）：適用填充針等有管腔的零件，定量溶劑通過管腔後收集分析，表面積精確已知，限度計算最為準確。
blocks.en: Lumen flush: suitable for parts with a lumen, such as filling needles; a measured volume of solvent is passed through the lumen and collected for analysis. The surface area is precisely known, so the limit calculation is the most accurate.

blocks.zh: Swab Sampling | 棉棒取樣
blocks.en: Swab Sampling

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣步驟流程
blocks.en: Swab Sampling Procedure

blocks.zh: 溼潤棉棒（通常用純水）
blocks.en: Moisten the swab (usually with purified water)

blocks.zh: 依規定動作擦拭表面
blocks.en: Wipe the surface using the specified motion

blocks.zh: 棉棒放入溶劑解吸
blocks.en: Place the swab in solvent for desorption

blocks.zh: 溶劑分析（TOC/蛋白質等）
blocks.en: Analyze the solvent (TOC, protein, etc.)

blocks.zh: 多支棉棒策略
blocks.en: Multiple-Swab Strategy

blocks.zh: 在同一取樣點使用多支棉棒（第一支濕棒 + 第二支乾棒）可提高回收率。第二支棉棒可以是乾棒或再次濕潤的棒，用於擷取第一支未能完全收集的殘留物。
blocks.en: Using more than one swab at the same sampling location (a first wet swab followed by a second dry swab) can improve recovery. The second swab can be dry or re-moistened, and is used to pick up residue that the first swab did not fully collect.

blocks.zh: TOC 分析時，棉棒必須注意外部有機碳的污染。類似微生物取樣的無菌技術理念，避免手套上的有機物（如異丙醇）污染棉棒，否則會造成偽高 TOC 值。
blocks.en: For TOC analysis, take care that the swab is not contaminated by external organic carbon. Apply the same idea as aseptic technique in microbial sampling, and keep organic material on gloves (such as isopropanol) from contaminating the swab, or it will cause falsely high TOC values.

blocks.zh: Comparison of Swab and Rinse Sampling | 棉棒與沖洗取樣比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Swab and Rinse Sampling

blocks.zh: 不使用棉棒的合理性論證
blocks.en: Justification for Not Using Swabs

blocks.zh: 若管道等區域無法棉棒取樣，需有書面理由支持。六個合理性條件：
blocks.en: If areas such as piping cannot be swabbed, a written rationale is needed. The six justification conditions are:

blocks.zh: 材質相同（與可取樣區）
blocks.en: Same material (as the swabbable areas)

blocks.zh: 殘留條件相同
blocks.en: Same residue conditions

blocks.zh: 清潔程序相同
blocks.en: Same cleaning procedure

blocks.zh: 管道機械力（湍流）更高
blocks.en: Higher mechanical force (turbulence) in the piping

blocks.zh: 管道完全充滿液體
blocks.en: Piping completely filled with liquid

blocks.zh: 沖洗取樣已有效覆蓋
blocks.en: Rinse sampling already provides effective coverage

blocks.zh: 這六點需在驗證文件中明確陳述。
blocks.en: These six points must be stated explicitly in the validation documents.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1
blocks.en: Thought Exercise 1

blocks.zh: 您的工廠有一條 50m 長的不鏽鋼輸送管道，連接配製槽與填充機，清潔方式為 CIP。在清潔驗證取樣計畫中，您會如何合理說明不對此管道進行棉棒取樣？請列出至少三個合理性論點。
blocks.en: Your plant has a 50 m stainless steel transfer line connecting the formulation tank to the filling machine, and it is cleaned by CIP. In the cleaning validation sampling plan, how would you justify not swabbing this line? List at least three justification points.

blocks.zh: Placebo Sampling | 安慰劑取樣
blocks.en: Placebo Sampling

blocks.zh: 生技安慰劑取樣的特殊性
blocks.en: What Is Special About Placebo Sampling for Biologics

blocks.zh: 一般製藥的安慰劑可能包含輔料配方，但生技產品的「安慰劑」在 TR49 中特指使用 注射用水（WFI） 或 水性緩衝液，不含任何活性蛋白成分。
blocks.en: A placebo in conventional pharmaceuticals may contain an excipient formulation, but in TR49 the "placebo" for biotech products specifically means water for injection (WFI) or an aqueous buffer, containing no active protein.

blocks.zh: 清潔後，以此溶液模擬製程操作，再分析溶液中是否含有殘留物（蛋白質、TOC、內毒素等），以證明實際的殘留帶入量（Carryover）。
blocks.en: After cleaning, this solution is used to simulate process operations, and the solution is then analyzed for residues (protein, TOC, endotoxin, etc.) to demonstrate the actual carryover.

blocks.zh: 就像洗完鍋子後，用清水煮一次白飯，看白飯是否有異味或顏色——這就是安慰劑概念：用「無害替代品」模擬實際使用，確認清潔效果。
blocks.en: It is like boiling plain water or cooking a pot of white rice after washing a pot, then checking the rice for off-odors or color. That is the placebo concept: simulate actual use with a "harmless substitute" to confirm the cleaning result.

blocks.zh: 分析項目提醒
blocks.en: Analytical Reminder

blocks.zh: 安慰劑樣品通常分析：TOC（或總蛋白質）、導電度、生物負荷（Bioburden）、內毒素（Endotoxin）。這四項涵蓋化學殘留與微生物安全兩個維度。
blocks.en: Placebo samples are usually analyzed for TOC (or total protein), conductivity, bioburden, and endotoxin. These four tests cover both dimensions: chemical residue and microbial safety.

blocks.zh: Sampling for Microbial and Endotoxin Analysis | 微生物與內毒素取樣
blocks.en: Sampling for Microbial and Endotoxin Analysis

blocks.zh: 微生物取樣三種方式
blocks.en: Three Ways to Sample for Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 沖洗水取樣：必須使用無菌容器，最常用
blocks.en: Rinse water sampling: a sterile container must be used; the most common

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣：用於特定表面點位
blocks.en: Swab sampling: used at specific surface locations

blocks.zh: 接觸碟（Contact Plates）：RODAC 碟，直接按壓表面
blocks.en: Contact plates: RODAC plates, pressed directly onto the surface

blocks.zh: 關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key Requirement

blocks.zh: 所有微生物取樣的核心要求：防止外部污染。沖洗水樣品必須用無菌容器收集，否則結果無效。
blocks.en: The core requirement for all microbial sampling is to prevent external contamination. Rinse water samples must be collected in sterile containers, or the result is invalid.

blocks.zh: 內毒素取樣幾乎固定採用沖洗水樣品（非棉棒），因為內毒素分析方法（LAL）需要液態樣品。
blocks.en: Endotoxin sampling almost always uses rinse water samples (not swabs), because the endotoxin assay (LAL) requires a liquid sample.

blocks.zh: 生技清潔驗證在微生物取樣方式上與一般製藥並無特殊差異。
blocks.en: For microbial sampling methods, biotech cleaning validation is no different from conventional pharmaceutical cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: Sampling Recovery Studies | 取樣回收率研究
blocks.en: Sampling Recovery Studies

blocks.zh: 回收率研究的目的
blocks.en: Purpose of a Recovery Study

blocks.zh: 回收率研究（Recovery Study）回答一個核心問題：「如果殘留存在於表面，我們的取樣方法能測量到多少？」
blocks.en: A recovery study answers one core question: "If residue is present on the surface, how much of it can our sampling method measure?"

blocks.zh: 研究使用材質試片（Coupon），以已知濃度的殘留物加標（Spike），再執行實際取樣流程，計算回收百分比。
blocks.en: The study uses coupons of the material, spiked with residue at a known concentration; the actual sampling procedure is then carried out and the percent recovery is calculated.

blocks.zh: 加標設計原則
blocks.en: Spiking Design Principles

blocks.zh: 加標量 = 殘留限度（Worst Case）：不要用低濃度，因為這才是驗證臨界情況的方式
blocks.en: Spike amount = residue limit (worst case): do not use a low concentration, because this is how the critical case is verified

blocks.zh: 加標物質：應為清潔後實際存在的殘留（降解蛋白），但使用原始活性蛋白也可接受（更保守）
blocks.en: Spiking material: should be the residue actually present after cleaning (degraded protein), but using the original active protein is also acceptable (more conservative)

blocks.zh: 材質覆蓋：必須涵蓋所有取樣表面材質（SS、玻璃、PTFE、矽膠等）
blocks.en: Material coverage: must cover all sampled surface materials (SS, glass, PTFE, silicone, etc.)

blocks.zh: 分組策略（Grouping/Family Approach）
blocks.en: Grouping Strategy (Family Approach)

blocks.zh: 並非每個表面都需要獨立做回收率研究。可將相同材質或相似特性的表面分組，以最具代表性的一個表面做研究，其他表面引用該數據。
blocks.en: Not every surface needs its own recovery study. Surfaces of the same material or similar characteristics can be grouped, with the study performed on the most representative surface and the other surfaces referencing those data.

blocks.zh: 對於佔總表面積比例極小的材質（<1-2%），可直接使用所有已研究材質中最低的回收率值作為保守估計。
blocks.en: For materials that make up a very small proportion of the total surface area (<1-2%), the lowest recovery value among all the materials studied can be used directly as a conservative estimate.

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣面積調整原則
blocks.en: Principle for Adjusting the Swab Sampling Area

blocks.zh:
標準取樣面積：25 cm² 或 100 cm²
接受範圍：標準面積的 25% ~ 150%
若實際取樣面積偏離標準值，
則殘留限度需依實際面積進行比例調整

例：標準 100 cm²，實際取樣 60 cm²
→ 殘留限度 = 原限度 × (60/100)
blocks.en:
Standard sampling area: 25 cm² or 100 cm²
Acceptable range: 25% to 150% of the standard area
If the actual sampling area deviates from the standard,
the residue limit must be adjusted in proportion to the actual area

Example: standard 100 cm², actual sampling 60 cm²
→ residue limit = original limit × (60/100)

blocks.zh: Swab Recovery | 棉棒回收率
blocks.en: Swab Recovery

blocks.zh: 棉棒回收率研究設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Designing a Swab Recovery Study

blocks.zh: 重複次數：每位分析員至少 3 個重複
blocks.en: Replicates: at least 3 replicates per analyst

blocks.zh: 分析員數量：至少 2 位，因棉棒取樣高度依賴人員操作
blocks.en: Number of analysts: at least 2, because swab sampling depends heavily on the operator

blocks.zh: 回收率定義：取所有分析員中最低的平均值（最保守）
blocks.en: Definition of recovery: take the lowest mean among all analysts (the most conservative)

blocks.zh: 加標濃度：在殘留限度水準（而非多個濃度）
blocks.en: Spiking concentration: at the residue limit level (rather than multiple concentrations)

blocks.zh: 棉棒回收率接受標準
blocks.en: Swab Recovery Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh:
情境一：不校正限度或結果
→ 回收率 ≥ 70%

情境二：用於校正殘留限度或分析結果
→ 回收率 ≥ 50%

變異度：同一加標水準，
可接受 RSD = 15~30%

注意：需同時設定回收率上限
blocks.en:
Scenario 1: limit or result is not corrected
→ recovery ≥ 70%

Scenario 2: used to correct the residue limit or the analytical result
→ recovery ≥ 50%

Variability: at the same spiking level,
acceptable RSD = 15–30%

Note: an upper limit for recovery must also be set

blocks.zh: 為何要求兩位分析員？
blocks.en: Why are two analysts required?

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣是手動操作，不同人的施力、手法差異顯著影響回收率。使用兩位分析員的數據，可評估方法的操作員間變異，確保取樣方法的穩健性，不依賴單一人員的技巧。
blocks.en: Swabbing is a manual operation, and differences between people in applied pressure and technique significantly affect recovery. Using data from two analysts allows the inter-operator variability of the method to be assessed, ensuring that the sampling method is robust and does not depend on the skill of a single person.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2
blocks.en: Thought Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 某分析員 A 的平均棉棒回收率為 68%，分析員 B 為 75%。依據 TR49，若公司決定不對限度或結果進行校正，此回收率研究是否通過？若不通過，您會採取什麼措施？
blocks.en: Analyst A has a mean swab recovery of 68%, and Analyst B has 75%. According to TR49, if the company decides not to correct the limit or the results, does this recovery study pass? If not, what action would you take?

blocks.zh: Rinse Recovery | 沖洗回收率
blocks.en: Rinse Recovery

blocks.zh: FDA 類比解釋
blocks.en: Explanation of the FDA Analogies

blocks.zh: TR49 提到 FDA 的兩個比喻，說明為何需要做沖洗回收率研究：
blocks.en: TR49 cites two FDA analogies to explain why a rinse recovery study is needed:

blocks.zh: "Dirty Pot"（髒鍋）：鍋子洗不乾淨，但沖洗水測不出來——殘留附著在表面，水沖不下來
blocks.en: "Dirty Pot": the pot is not clean, but the rinse water shows nothing, because the residue is stuck to the surface and the water cannot wash it off

blocks.zh: "Baby/Bath Water"（洗澡水）：沖洗水被大量稀釋，即使有殘留也偵測不到
blocks.en: "Baby/Bath Water": the rinse water is heavily diluted, so even if residue is present it cannot be detected

blocks.zh: 回收率研究正是要證明：殘留能被沖洗下來，且濃度足以被分析方法偵測到。
blocks.en: A recovery study is exactly what demonstrates that the residue can be rinsed off, and at a concentration high enough for the analytical method to detect.

blocks.zh: 沖洗模擬的關鍵原則
blocks.en: Key Principles for Rinse Simulation

blocks.zh: 實驗室無法完全複製大型設備的 CIP 沖洗過程，但必須確保：
blocks.en: A laboratory cannot fully replicate the CIP rinse of large equipment, but it must ensure that:

blocks.zh: 溶劑類型相同（通常為純水）
blocks.en: The solvent type is the same (usually purified water)

blocks.zh: 溫度相同或更嚴格
blocks.en: The temperature is the same or more stringent

blocks.zh: 溶劑量/表面積比值 ≤ 設備實際比值（最差情況：比值更小，稀釋效果更少）
blocks.en: The solvent volume/surface area ratio is ≤ the actual equipment ratio (worst case: a smaller ratio gives less dilution)

blocks.zh: 與棉棒回收率不同：沖洗回收率只需 1 位操作員 × 3 重複，因為沖洗步驟操作員依賴性低。
blocks.en: Unlike swab recovery, rinse recovery needs only 1 operator × 3 replicates, because the rinse step has low operator dependence.

blocks.zh: "Recovery" in Visual Inspection | 目視檢查的「回收率」
blocks.en: "Recovery" in Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 目視「回收率」= 偵測限研究
blocks.en: Visual "recovery" = detection limit study

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的「回收率」概念與棉棒/沖洗不同，它實際上是確定目視偵測限（Visual Detection Limit）：在規定條件下，人眼能看到的最低殘留量（μg/cm²）。
blocks.en: The "recovery" concept for visual inspection differs from swab and rinse. It is actually about determining the visual detection limit: the lowest amount of residue (μg/cm²) the human eye can see under defined conditions.

blocks.zh: 何時需要目視偵測限研究？
blocks.en: When is a visual detection limit study needed?

blocks.zh: 需要：當目視檢查是唯一取樣/判定方法時（無棉棒或沖洗作為補充）。
blocks.en: Needed: when visual inspection is the only sampling/assessment method (no swab or rinse as a supplement).

blocks.zh: 不需要：目視只是補充棉棒或沖洗取樣，不作為主要判定依據。
blocks.en: Not needed: when visual inspection only supplements swab or rinse sampling and is not the primary basis for the decision.

blocks.zh: 目視偵測限設定方法
blocks.en: Method for Setting the Visual Detection Limit

blocks.zh:
步驟：
1. 準備不同殘留濃度的試片（μg/cm²）
2. 在規定條件下（距離、光源、角度）
3. 由多位訓練觀察員判斷
4. 確定「清楚可見」的最低濃度

文獻典型值：1–4 μg/cm²

影響因素：
- 殘留物本身性質（顏色、質地）
- 表面材質（不鏽鋼 vs. PTFE）
- 觀察員視力
blocks.en:
Steps:
1. Prepare coupons with different residue concentrations (μg/cm²)
2. Under defined conditions (distance, light source, angle)
3. Have several trained observers make the judgment
4. Determine the lowest concentration that is "clearly visible"

Typical literature values: 1–4 μg/cm²

Influencing factors:
- Properties of the residue itself (color, texture)
- Surface material (stainless steel vs. PTFE)
- Observer eyesight

blocks.zh: 實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Significance

blocks.zh: 若清潔驗證方案中設備目視清潔的觀察條件 ≥ 偵測限研究條件（更嚴格），則「目視清潔」等同於「殘留低於偵測限」。這提供了目視判定的科學依據。
blocks.en: If the observation conditions for visual cleanliness of equipment in the cleaning validation program are ≥ the conditions of the detection limit study (that is, more stringent), then "visually clean" is equivalent to "residue below the detection limit". This provides a scientific basis for the visual assessment.

blocks.zh: Recovery for Bioburden and Endotoxin Sampling | 生物負荷與內毒素回收率
blocks.en: Recovery for Bioburden and Endotoxin Sampling

blocks.zh: 為何微生物不做回收率研究？
blocks.en: Why is no recovery study done for microorganisms?

blocks.zh: 這是許多人容易疑惑的問題。TR49 給出四個明確理由：
blocks.en: This question confuses many people. TR49 gives four clear reasons:

blocks.zh: 計數單位問題：微生物用菌落形成單位（CFU）計數，不是分子計數，無法用百分比回收率表達
blocks.en: Counting unit problem: microorganisms are counted in colony-forming units (CFU), not as molecules, so they cannot be expressed as a percent recovery

blocks.zh: 乾燥致死問題：在試片上乾燥加標過程中，活菌會死亡，造成加標回收率完全失真
blocks.en: Desiccation problem: during the drying step of spiking onto a coupon, viable organisms die, which completely distorts the spike recovery

blocks.zh: 菌種選擇不明：不知道要用哪個菌種做加標
blocks.en: Unclear choice of organism: it is not known which organism should be used for spiking

blocks.zh: 限度足夠保守：生物負荷限度設定本就遠低於可能造成問題的水準，即使回收率低也不影響產品安全
blocks.en: Limits are sufficiently conservative: bioburden limits are set well below the level that could cause problems, so even a low recovery does not affect product safety

blocks.zh: 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points

blocks.zh: 在 GMP 審計中，驗證人員無需為微生物/內毒素取樣提供回收率數據。但需確保取樣方法本身的適當性（如無菌容器、避免外部污染）。
blocks.en: In a GMP audit, validation staff do not need to provide recovery data for microbial/endotoxin sampling. They must, however, ensure that the sampling method itself is appropriate (for example, sterile containers and avoidance of external contamination).

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3
blocks.en: Thought Exercise 3

blocks.zh: 審計員質疑：「你們的清潔驗證報告中，微生物取樣的回收率研究在哪裡？」請根據 TR49 Section 5.4.5，起草一份簡短的書面回應，解釋為何微生物取樣不需要（且不適合）回收率研究。
blocks.en: An auditor asks: "Where is the recovery study for microbial sampling in your cleaning validation report?" Based on TR49 Section 5.4.5, draft a short written response explaining why microbial sampling does not need (and is not suited to) a recovery study.

blocks.zh: Training and Qualification of Samplers | 取樣人員訓練與資格認定
blocks.en: Training and Qualification of Samplers

blocks.zh: 棉棒取樣的四大一致性要素
blocks.en: Four Consistency Factors in Swab Sampling

blocks.zh: 棉頭濕潤度：過濕或過乾都影響回收率
blocks.en: Swab head moisture: too wet or too dry affects recovery

blocks.zh: 擦拭動作：需有重疊筆畫（overlapping strokes），確保完整覆蓋
blocks.en: Wiping motion: overlapping strokes are required to ensure complete coverage

blocks.zh: 施力大小：力量太輕收不到殘留，太重可能損傷表面
blocks.en: Applied pressure: too light will not pick up the residue, too heavy may damage the surface

blocks.zh: 取樣面積：必須與回收率研究的面積一致
blocks.en: Sampling area: must match the area used in the recovery study

blocks.zh: 第五要素（TOC 特別注意）：避免手套上的有機物（如異丙醇）污染棉棒！使用 IPA 擦手後再取樣會造成偽高 TOC。
blocks.en: The fifth factor (special attention for TOC): avoid organic material on gloves (such as isopropanol) contaminating the swab! Sampling after wiping hands with IPA will cause falsely high TOC.

blocks.zh: 沖洗取樣的關鍵要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Rinse Sampling

blocks.zh: 取樣口清潔：取樣前需充分沖洗取樣閥/取樣口，防止殘留污染
blocks.en: Sampling port cleanliness: the sampling valve/port must be thoroughly flushed before sampling to prevent residue contamination

blocks.zh: 時機點：通常取最後沖洗水的最後部分（最嚴格條件）；一旦 CIP 結束就沒有機會補取
blocks.en: Timing: normally the last portion of the final rinse water is taken (the most stringent condition); once the CIP ends there is no chance to take a sample again

blocks.zh: 異丙醇問題：不要用 IPA 清潔取樣口，原因同棉棒——會造成偽高 TOC
blocks.en: Isopropanol issue: do not clean the sampling port with IPA, for the same reason as for swabs: it causes falsely high TOC

blocks.zh: 重新訓練/認定的觸發情境
blocks.en: Situations That Trigger Retraining/Requalification

blocks.zh: 定期（例行）重新資格認定
blocks.en: Periodic (routine) requalification

blocks.zh: 取樣程序變更（Change Control）
blocks.en: Change to the sampling procedure (change control)

blocks.zh: 不合格結果調查中懷疑操作員錯誤
blocks.en: Operator error suspected in an out-of-specification result investigation

blocks.zh: 目視檢查訓練的三個判定類別
blocks.en: Three Assessment Categories in Visual Inspection Training

blocks.zh: 用於偵測限研究的訓練，觀察員必須能清楚區分：
blocks.en: For training used in detection limit studies, observers must be able to clearly distinguish:

blocks.zh: 目視清潔（Visually Clean）：表面無可見殘留
blocks.en: Visually Clean: no visible residue on the surface

blocks.zh: 局部污染（Partially Soiled）：部分區域有殘留可見
blocks.en: Partially Soiled: residue visible in some areas

blocks.zh: 完全污染（Fully Soiled）：整體可見殘留
blocks.en: Fully Soiled: residue visible over the whole surface

blocks.zh: 訓練時需特別強調：區分「殘留」與「表面缺陷/瑕疵」，兩者判定結果不同。
blocks.en: Training must particularly stress distinguishing "residue" from "surface defects/blemishes", because the two are judged differently.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4（綜合）
blocks.en: Thought Exercise 4 (Integrated)

blocks.zh: 您正在建立生技工廠清潔驗證的取樣人員訓練計畫。針對棉棒取樣人員，請列出：(a) 初次訓練的最低要求步驟、(b) 資格認定的方式、(c) 哪些情況需要啟動重新訓練/認定？
blocks.en: You are establishing a sampler training program for cleaning validation in a biotech plant. For swab samplers, list: (a) the minimum steps required for initial training, (b) how qualification is done, and (c) which situations require retraining/requalification.
